_note: Fixed probe for validating the warm-pencil-family visual language. Only the style block should vary during onboarding.
subject: A fixed 16:9 educational hand-drawn scene on a warm off-white background. Three small asymmetric knowledge-story clusters with substantial untouched negative space. Upper-left cluster: a simple calendar, a soccer ball, a school backpack and a small book stack, suggesting an overfilled child's schedule. Center cluster: the canonical father, mother and elementary-school-age child sitting together calmly; father has short dark gray-brown hair and a light-blue shirt, mother has shoulder-length dark hair and a pale-yellow top, child has short dark hair and a soft-green top. Lower-center cluster: the same father and child in a simple everyday action where the child tries something independently while the father stays nearby without taking over. Use fine dark gray-brown colored-pencil contours and only sparse low-saturation macaron accents. Keep the composition airy and diagrammatic, not a full room illustration. No readable text, no numbers, no letters, no logos, no subtitles, no UI, no decorative border, no generated hand or pencil entering the frame. Every human head must be complete, with deliberate hair mass, two eyes with one tiny highlight each, a simple mouth and subtle blush; never floating eyes or mask-like faces.
